_bossComment: The Bosses page. Defaults are VANILLA: the server rolls each map's own BossChance once per raid, seeded from the raid id (emu/raid.rollBossSpawnList). Before this existed nothing read BossChance at all and every boss in a map's BossLocationSpawn spawned every raid -- one live Woods raid produced Shturman, the Goons, Partisan and the Cultists together, which the data puts at 0.07%.
_lootComment: The Loot page. Every default below is the behaviour this emulator shipped with, so an untouched config generates the same floor it always did -- emu/loot.selfCheck asserts exactly that ('every new knob at its default reproduces the previous floor EXACTLY'). lootPreset is MOMENTARY (it writes the rows below and the page then shows what it wrote) and lootSummary is written BY the server, the same way spawnNow/spawnResult work. Docs: docs/LOOT-CONFIG.md.
_menuCornerLabel: Profile Name | PVE ZONE | No text. The literal key name is also this feature's deploy marker (tools/deploy.json) -- do not rename it without moving the marker.
_mapsComment: Which maps the player may load into. Writes locations.<map>.base.Locked, which /client/locations sends verbatim; Enabled is deliberately NOT written (BSG's own reply for this build carries Enabled=false on 9 of 24 maps as its own axis). Map names in the two lists may be spelled any way -- database key (bigmap), client Id (Woods, RezervBase) or _Id GUID -- because they go through emu/raid.canonicalLocation; only 4 of 19 maps spell key and Id alike. mapsLockResult is written BY the server after each apply and names any map that resolved to nothing.
_spawnComment: The Spawn Items row group. spawnNow is MOMENTARY -- onTarkovSettings intercepts the POST, runs the spawn and writes the key back to false -- and spawnResult is written BY the server, not by the player. They are still ordinary persisted keys, which is what lets the page render the last outcome after a reload; they are listed here so that no declared setting is missing a path (tools/settingscheck.py).
